title: Run an interview call
summary: The candidate's video call in the site, with their details, the rubric and the outcome beside it.

steps.text: Open the candidate from Calls, then Join the interview call. They join from the link in their email, no account needed.
Allow your camera and microphone, then Join the call. The room is private to this slot.
Their details, answers and the role's questions are beside the video: score the rubric as you talk.
After the call: No show or Not hired here, or Hire and the decision email from the candidate's page.
